title: Odyssey-3 drives a car in India and runs humanoids from one world model
key_facts: Odyssey, a Palo Alto AI lab, launched Odyssey-3, a world model, as a research preview on Thursday (8 Oct 2026).
A world model learns from visual data to predict how a scene will change, including how actions affect it.
Odyssey says it can control robot arms and humanoids, drive a car, fly drones and play video games.
Odyssey-3 Pro scored 66.1 on the video-to-video test of Physics-IQ Verified, the highest reported on that leaderboard, per Odyssey (best of eight attempts per task).
It also ranked first in three of four WorldMark categories, from the company's own evaluation.
A driving policy trained on about 20 hours of data drove a car on real roads in India; humanoid maker Flexion built control policies on the model.
Odyssey raised $310 million at a $1.45 billion valuation in June, with Amazon and AMD Ventures among investors.
